title: US Senate Narrowly Rejects Resolution to Curb Trump's Iran War Powers, 49-50
detail: The US Senate failed 49-50 to advance a concurrent resolution — already passed by the House 214-208 in July — that would have directed President Trump to remove US forces from hostilities against Iran absent a declaration of war or specific congressional authorization. Republicans Rand Paul, Susan Collins, Lisa Murkowski and Thom Tillis joined Democrats in favor; Democrat John Fetterman voted against it. As a concurrent resolution it would not have gone to the president for signature.

media.caption: The Senate narrowly voted down a resolution to curb President Trump's war powers over Iran

title: UAE Suspends Iranian Airline Flights Under US Sanctions Pressure
detail: The UAE's General Civil Aviation Authority suspended all flights by Iranian carriers (Iran Air, Iran Airtour, Kish Air, Qeshm Air) to and from the UAE effective Sept 24, complying with a US Treasury threat of secondary sanctions — including dollar-system exclusion — against airports and fuel/ground-handling providers that continue serving Iranian airlines. The UAE joins Oman, Iraq, Azerbaijan, Georgia and Turkmenistan in restricting Iranian carriers. Iran retaliated by barring UAE-registered aircraft (Emirates, Etihad, flydubai) from its airspace.

media.caption: The UAE suspended flights by Iranian carriers under US sanctions pressure
